ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping web dashboard built explicitly for the Vibe Coding Challenge constraint of 45 minutes, packing responsive layout generation and live AI tooling integration.
ideas.problem_statement: Junior Track Vibe Coding Challenge (45 mins): Build a functional, responsive web solution using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and permitted AI tools.
ideas.title: VibeCheck Web Studio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the 6-mark Functionality and 4-mark Ease of Access evaluation criteria by pre-bundling high-contrast responsive layouts and clean DOM manipulation utilities.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight local debugging helper designed to instantly parse runtime errors and output structured fix plans for round-one technical qualifiers.
ideas.problem_statement: Senior Track Round 1 – Technical Qualifier: SE tackles 2 Debugging + 3 Problem-Solving questions under tight time limits.
ideas.title: DebugPulse AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges and competitors feel acutely during the rapid 45-minute debugging round by reducing stacktrace analysis time.

ideas.pitch: An interactive DSA challenge tracker and code sandbox that helps teams rapidly decode lock digits and practice graph/tree algorithms under escape-room time pressure.
ideas.problem_statement: Senior Track Round 2 – DSA Escape Challenge: Top 25% qualifying teams solve DSA challenges to uncover lock digits and crack the final escape mechanism.
ideas.title: EscapeLock DSA Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the core algorithmic problem-solving theme of CodeStorm by turning raw DSA code testing into a gamified puzzle-solving dashboard.

ideas.pitch: A local browser compliance monitor and focus timer built to help participants avoid accidental tab-switch penalties during high-stakes anti-cheating rounds.
ideas.problem_statement: Rules & Anti-Cheating: Tab-Switching is monitored automatically during SE/TE/BE rounds with strict warnings and disqualification thresholds.
ideas.title: TabGuard Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the strict anti-cheating rulebook enforced by the organizing committee, providing immediate utility to event participants.

ideas.pitch: A responsive real-time event portal providing countdown timers, live leaderboard standings, and quick access rules reference for CodeStorm Escape Room attendees.
ideas.problem_statement: Escape Room is a technical challenge organized by CodeStorm testing coding, algorithmic problem-solving, debugging, and teamwork under time pressure.
ideas.title: CodeStorm Event Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the event organisers and participants directly, ensuring high engagement during the live demo presentation.
